metadata.purpose: Preserve official 51st General Assembly corrections affecting the 2022 Overture 15 recorded-negative-vote roster and the 2023 Overture 15 presbytery-ratification totals.

corrections.correction_summary: The 51st GA Corrections to the Minutes of the 49th General Assembly states that Danny Morgan's name was inadvertently left off the Overture 15 negative-vote roster.
corrections.controlling_semantics: The corrected official person-level roster contains 200 recorded negative votes. Danny Morgan is preserved as a later official correction rather than silently inserted as though his name appeared in the original 49th-GA printed roster.

corrections.correction_summary: The 51st GA states that the 50th GA published tally omitted the onsite revision reflecting the most up-to-date presbytery votes.
corrections.controlling_semantics: The corrected 48-32 total with 80 presbyteries reporting controls the amendment-lifecycle result. The previously normalized 88-row 50th-GA table is retained only as a superseded published snapshot and is not rewritten with guessed per-presbytery revisions.

guardrails: A later official correction supersedes the erroneous aggregate or roster total without erasing the historical fact that the earlier minutes printed a different value.
No corrected individual presbytery vote is inferred unless the correction source identifies that presbytery's revised action.
Recorded negative-vote status establishes the recorded vote on the final Overture 15 action only and does not establish the voter's rationale or position on Overture 29 or the Human Sexuality Report.
